title: Technology Sector Update for 01/03/2018: BB,BB.TO,BIDU,INTC,AMD,SPNS,ORCL
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +0.51%
AAPL +0.61%
IBM +3.09%
CSCO +0.41%
GOOG +1.85%
Technology stocks were firming again on Wednesday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding almost 0.7% in value while the Philadelphia semiconductor index was posting a nearly 1.1% gain.
In industry news:
- Selected chipmakers, including Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ), advanced Wednesday following reports of potential security flaws in rival Intel ( INTC ) chips. But in a new research note, analysts at Raymond James said while the situation - if true - was a "black eye" for Intel, it was unlikely to significantly harm the company's financial performance, explaining there are few alternatives to Intel chips. The Raymond James analysts also said if an expected security patch for Intel chips slows older PCs, that could encourage users to upgrade their devices and providing an added lift for Intel.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
BlackBerry Ltd (BB,BB.TO) was surging Wednesday, at one point climbing almost 8% to a session high of $12.94 a share, after the smartphone company said it has signed a letter of intent with Chinese online retailer Baidu ( BIDU ) that would make BlackBerry's operating system the foundation for Baidu's Apollo autonomous-driving platform. The companies will collaborate to integrate Baidu's CarLife smartphone software for connected cars in China as well as its DuerOS artificial intelligence platform and high definition maps with the BlackBerry QNX car platform. Baidu shares were narrowly lower this afternoon.
In other sector news:
+ Sapiens ( SPNS ) was higher after the financial software company Wednesday acquired digital insurance service provider KnowledgePrice. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
- Oracle ( ORCL ) advanced following an upgrade of the business software firm to Overweight from Equal Weight by analysts at Morgan Stanley.
